title: AquaType
description:
A Zhuyin input method for Mac that suggests the right words even when you press the wrong keys. Built on RIME (Squirrel), with a noisy-channel decoding engine that runs entirely on device.

AquaType is made of parts under different licenses: the input method (a modified version of Squirrel) under GPL-3.0, the engine and the decoder under Apache-2.0, and the trained model under CC BY-NC 4.0. See LICENSE and NOTICE.txt.
